notation: Plain ASCII after the same rules as normalize_scientific_text (no LaTeX in Gold).
Unit powers use caret: m^2, cm^3, g^-1 (not m2 / cm3).
Multi-level headers join with _: Phase content (%)_A (pipeline flatten).
Angstrom as A; micro as u (umol).
Header footnotes (^a, †) are not part of the evaluable label.
section_title: Gold uses the discussing section (semantic), verified by a human against the PDF.
Automatic silver uses the closest article-section heading above the table float (positional).
Exact section_title is therefore not the primary OCR-selection metric; use soft token-F1.
Gold sections are NOT copied from silver predictions.
mentions: Gold keeps concise in-text sentences that cite the table.
Silver often stores the full OCR paragraph; soft mention recall is the fair metric.

selection_criteria: native PDF text exposes every cell (no image-only tables)
mix of characterisation, EDS, activity and transposed layouts
domain coverage: lattice/phase, textural, band gap, metal loading, CO2 ads, formic-acid yield
